name: smwmusic-front-mission-gun-hazard-mission-complete
title: Front Mission: Gun Hazard - Mission Complete
description:
The song that plays after you beat a level in Gun Hazard. Could probably fit a castle destruction scene.

Includes an option to skip the intro (0:00-0:03) (Insert size will be 0x019F bytes)

Update (1/30/2024):
- Added an intro only version (For when a castle is blown up, which is before any text appears in the black part of the screen) (Size is 0x006F bytes)
